progress_policy.aggregation: Parent progress is the equal-weight mean of immediate children; only branches containing tracked leaf work are synchronized; leaf completion is never inferred.
progress_policy.completion_rule: تکمیل فقط با معیار پذیرش پاس‌شده و شواهد قابل بررسی ثبت شود.

test_evidence: CI 40715257341 passed: 12 Node tests, migrations 0001/0002 on local D1, Worker runtime and Chromium end-to-end smoke.
Tests cover scoped user creation, role assignment, cross-company denial, organization lifecycle and session revocation on user deactivation.
acceptance_criteria: Current slice: D1 schema defines org_units with unique code, parent foreign key, allowed unit types/status, creator reference and timestamps.
Remaining: finalize company/tenant lifecycle and data retention rules for the complete multi-company module.
children.next_action: Review organization data retention and company-scoped uniqueness requirements.

children.name: ثبت معیارهای پذیرش و خطاهای قابل انتظار
منطق سمت سرور و API امن
پیاده‌سازی عملیات سمت سرور و کنترل دسترسی
test_evidence: CI 40715257341 passed: 12 Node tests, migrations 0001/0002 on local D1, Worker runtime and Chromium end-to-end smoke.
Tests cover scoped user creation, role assignment, cross-company denial, organization lifecycle and session revocation on user deactivation.
acceptance_criteria: Current slice: GET/POST/PATCH organization API, hierarchy cycle prevention, activation/deactivation, audit events and scope-aware permission checks.
Remaining: complete additional lifecycle and concurrency cases and expand pagination beyond the current 1000-row limit.
children.next_action: Add pagination and concurrency tests, then extend scoped access to future ERP resources.

children.name: افزودن کنترل دامنه سازمانی، حسابرسی و idempotency در صورت نیاز
رابط کاربری و تجربه عملیاتی
پیاده‌سازی فرم، جدول، جزئیات و وضعیت‌ها
test_evidence: CI 40715257341 passed: 12 Node tests, migrations 0001/0002 on local D1, Worker runtime and Chromium end-to-end smoke.
Tests cover scoped user creation, role assignment, cross-company denial, organization lifecycle and session revocation on user deactivation.
acceptance_criteria: Current slice: responsive Persian RTL forms/table for bootstrap/login, company/site create/edit, activation/deactivation, plus admin user creation/list/status controls.
Remaining: detailed record view, search/filter, editing user roles/scopes and status history.
children.next_action: Add user role/scope editing and detailed organization views.

children.name: اتصال رابط به API و مدیریت بارگذاری، خطا و حالت خالی
test_evidence: CI 40715257341 passed: 12 Node tests, migrations 0001/0002 on local D1, Worker runtime and Chromium end-to-end smoke.
Tests cover scoped user creation, role assignment, cross-company denial, organization lifecycle and session revocation on user deactivation.
acceptance_criteria: UI uses real Worker APIs and handles loading, empty, success and API errors.
Chromium smoke covers bootstrap/login, create/edit/activate/deactivate, scoped user creation and mobile RTL layout.
children.next_action: Add explicit browser checks for invalid forms, duplicate codes and network failure.

children.name: آزمون، امنیت و مستندات
نوشتن آزمون‌های موفق، نامعتبر و دسترسی غیرمجاز
test_evidence: CI 40715257341 passed: 12 Node tests, migrations 0001/0002 on local D1, Worker runtime and Chromium end-to-end smoke.
Tests cover scoped user creation, role assignment, cross-company denial, organization lifecycle and session revocation on user deactivation.
acceptance_criteria: Automated tests cover valid/invalid requests, unauthenticated access, invalid bootstrap secret, duplicate codes, hierarchy cycles, oversized JSON, login rate limiting, concurrent bootstrap, scoped RBAC and user lifecycle/session revocation.
children.next_action: Keep regression tests mandatory for future organization/RBAC changes.

children.name: اجرای آزمون یکپارچگی و ثبت شواهد و مستندات
test_evidence: CI 40715257341 passed: 12 Node tests, migrations 0001/0002 on local D1, Worker runtime and Chromium end-to-end smoke.
Tests cover scoped user creation, role assignment, cross-company denial, organization lifecycle and session revocation on user deactivation.
acceptance_criteria: Local D1 migrations are applied without remote access; Wrangler Worker and Chromium smoke exercise authentication, organization create/edit/status, scoped user provisioning and mobile RTL UI.
children.next_action: Repeat against a dedicated remote development D1 only after it is explicitly configured; never use the connectivity probe database.

Tests cover scoped user creation, role assignment, cross-company denial, organization lifecycle and session revocation on user deactivation.
acceptance_criteria: Current schema stores unique case-insensitive email, password hash, active/disabled status, roles and organization scopes.
Remaining: invitation, verification, recovery and user role/scope change history.
children.next_action: Design invitation and recovery fields/workflows through additive migrations.
